stats: Cooldown Recovery Rate modifies the speed at which your Skill cooldowns are restored. For example, with 100% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate your Skill cooldowns will effectively be halved.
Cooldown Recovery Rate does not affect anything other than Skill cooldowns.
